name: Wall Biceps Stretch
steps: Stand sideways beside a sturdy wall and press your nearer palm flat against the wall slightly behind you at shoulder height with fingers pointing back.
Keep your elbow straight and relax your stretching shoulder down away from your ear.
Turn your chest slowly away from the wall until you feel a clear, comfortable stretch along your biceps and front shoulder.
Hold steadily while breathing calmly for the target duration, then turn back gently and switch arms.
tips: Keep your shoulder blade down and back rather than letting the front of your shoulder roll forward.
Ease into a mild pulling sensation without forcing sharp tension into the front of the elbow.
